BodyParts3D anatomical meshes

Version 4.3 source redistribution: https://github.com/olivercase/body_parts_3d_api
Pinned source revision: fd527e6f4daf732fd814314d9257df5877b844bc
Original OBJ filenames and geometry are preserved. Each download is checked against its pinned Git LFS SHA-256 and size; this project stores real files in regular Git, not LFS pointers.

Older file/repository notices cite Attribution-ShareAlike 2.1 Japan. The saved current primary-publisher README records the 2025 database license update to Attribution 4.0 International. The redistribution's Python code is not included or executed.

Project modifications: native tissue meshes convert axes/units, reverse reflected winding and fit hip/eye references plus interior body envelopes on English Archer and Erika Archer. Source surfaces are grouped by organ and attached to their animated bones. Source geometry is unchanged; fitted native derivatives are project-owned assets under Assets/_Game/Models/Anatomy/. This registration is a game prototype, not subject-specific anatomical reconstruction.

Source inventory, original hashes, URLs, FMA concepts and rebuild input: SourceAssets/BodyParts3D/Sources.json
Preparation: SourceAssets/BodyParts3D/PrepareAnatomy.py

Replay presentation bones: BodyParts3D 4.0 part-of archive, from the same database.
PrepareReplayBones.py combines atlas pieces, centers and normalizes the resulting OBJ for rig fitting. These are game presentation meshes.
